rules.statement: APB PADDR must clear address bits [1:0] of the 32-bit AXI byte address.

rules.condition: A burst would cross a 4-KiB boundary
rules.statement: A burst that crosses a 4-KiB boundary must be rejected.
The 32-bit data path must not rotate byte lanes between AXI and APB.
An unsupported size must be answered with SLVERR.
The AXI ID must be echoed unchanged in the response without remapping.
AxSIZE values other than 0, 1 and 2 must be rejected.
The declared AxLEN (beats minus one, 1–256 beats) must control the expected beat count of the burst.
A reserved AxBURST value must be rejected; FIXED, INCR and WRAP are the legal values.
AxCACHE encodings other than 0000 and 0001 must be rejected; AxCACHE is used for validation only.
AxPROT must be copied directly to PPROT with no translation.
For subword writes, WSTRB must be copied to PSTRB unchanged.
The Manager must assert only PSTRB lanes legal for the address and size.
PRDATA must be returned in bus lanes, and the Manager selects the requested bytes using AXI address and size.
